pieces.say: Here's the fix. Turn on Private DNS.
Open Settings, Network and internet, Private DNS.
pieces.text: Open Settings, Network and internet, Private DNS.

pieces.say: Type dns dot adguard dash dns dot com, then Save.

elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Your Android can block a lot of ads with one hidden setting.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on Private DNS.

[friendly] Open Settings, Network and internet, Private DNS. Choose Private DNS provider hostname. Type dns dot adguard dash dns dot com, then Save.

[delighted] Fewer ads in your apps and browser, and nothing to install.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
coverLine: Your Android has a hidden ad filter
